messages:
emma: quick heads-up — i opened a tiny PR to fix two issues in the Console Observability guide: the tracing hooks example doesn't match SDK v2 and the cost/latency breakdown table has swapped columns 
alex: thanks — can you paste the failing snippet here?
maria: also link to the PR pls so i can review after lunch
emma: sure. snippet is the js tracer init:
emma: ```js
import {Tracing} from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const t = new Tracing({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
// current docs show `new Tracing()` with no args which breaks in v2
```
rishi: ah yep that would throw on startup, we changed to require auth in v2. good catch
emma: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/842
oliver: taking a peek — i'll do a quick pass on wording and the table formatting. do we want to keep the delta-per-model column?
maria: we should, but rename to "cost delta / 1k tokens" — current header is ambiguous
emma: agreed. also the latency column had p95 and p99 reversed in the csv -> table conversion. i updated that in the PR description
alex: can you add a one-line migration note for customers upgrading from SDK v1 -> v2? small snippet on how to import Tracing and pass apiKey
emma: yes will add a short migration block under "Tracing hooks"
emma: suggested text: "If you are migrating from SDK v1, replace `new Tracing()` with `new Tracing({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY})`. Ensure your service token has `tracing:write` scope"
oliver: looks good. tiny nit: use backticks around env var and scope name
emma: added backticks and pushed an extra commit
refs: docs-bot: commit 3f7a9c pushed to branch docs/tracing-fix (ci: check-docs passed)
docs-bot: CI: link-check failed on internal link /console/metrics#cost-breakdown — 404
maria: oh that explains why the in-page anchor doesn't work after the new headings change
rishi: i'll update the anchor in the console docs (k8s config landed yesterday) — will push a redirect in the docs router as well
alex: once link-check is green i'm happy to approve. could we also add a tiny SDK snippet for python users? one-liner for tracing init
emma: adding python snippet now:
emma: ```py
from redwood import Tracing
tracing = Tracing(api_key=os.environ["RW_KEY"])
```
oliver: nice. can you also include a short example showing how to attach tracing to an existing request handler? one small block would help users
emma: added a 5-line example with express and a note about async context
docs-bot: CI: link-check passed, lint passed, build-preview deployed at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/tracing-hooks
alex: approved in the PR, left one suggestion on wording for the cost delta label
emma: addressed alex's suggestion, squashed commits
emma: anyone want to do a final read for tone? otherwise i'll merge after 30m
maria: i'll give it a once-over in 20
oliver: LGTM from me, looks clear and the examples run locally
emma: merging in 10. thanks all! :tada:
docs-bot: PR merged by emma into main — 1751238167
